Kageaki(...)

en.html:
Cannon"Hm? Fair enough. Let us hope for something unexpected, then."
Cannon"What brings the three of you aboard?"
Kanae"A morning walk. It occurred to me that taking it in the sky for a change would be rather pleasant."
Cannon"Healthy living, very good. Not much entertainment so far, though?"
Kanae"You are planning to improve on that shortly, are you not, Lieutenant Colonel?"
Cannon"What would you mean by that?"
Kanae"A fireworks display, I hear? A little bird brought me the news."
Cannon"...A little bird・・・, is it. Hey, George. Watching from heaven? Since you went and died on Enoshima, this is the condition of our section’s information security."
Kageaki"..."
Cannon"Fireworks. Yes, we do have one large specimen to drop・・・."
Cannon"If you wished to watch, you should have booked beforehand. Guests are guests; naturally I would like to give you the best seats. But arriving all of a sudden makes it difficult."
Cannon"A gentleman neglecting his guests—what sort of name will that give me?"
Kanae"The discourtesy is ours; do not trouble yourself on our account. Besides, we have not come to watch."
Cannon"Oh? Some other purpose?"

en.html:
The occupation lieutenant colonel shrugged.

Why?

Why was he <ruby>letting us buy time<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>?
Without showing... the least suspicion.

For us, who wanted to prevent the bomb’s release, buying time was the condition for victory. For him, who wanted to drop it, the condition should have been the reverse: shorten the time.
He should have been taking the bomb back immediately.

And yet.


...The answer to the contradiction lay in reversing those conditions.

We were not the ones who needed to buy time.
<ruby>He was<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>. That was it.

Which meant—

ja.html:
進駐軍中佐が肩をすくめる。

　何故。

　何故、彼はこちらに時間を<ruby>稼がせる<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>？
　何も……疑念を示さずに。

　爆弾を投下させたくないこちらにとって時間を稼ぐ
事が勝利条件ならば、爆弾を投下したい彼の勝利条件
は時間を切り詰める事。
　即刻に爆弾を取り戻さねばならない筈だ。

　だというのに。


　……この矛盾を解く鍵は、勝利条件の逆転にある。

　時間を稼ぐ必要があったのは、こちらではなかった。
　<ruby>彼だった<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>。そういう事だ。

　つまり。
